name: Carolina Moretz
original_name: キャロライナ モレッツ
source: Wealthy business woman from wealthy family that owns many stores. After trying to just walk in without an appointment she forces the protagonist to work on her seeing as he was not busy just cleaning. After her massage she decides that she doesn't want anyone else doing massages for her other than protagonist.
